messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: Planned maintenance scheduled for us-west1 serving nodes — TOMORROW 2024-11-15 03:00-04:30 UTC. We'll drain a subset of serving nodes in waves. Potential transient 5-20s RPS/latency blips. Paging: @sre-aaron @eng-lina. Please acknowledge and post customer-facing comms.
sre-aaron: ack, taking pager. I'll run preflight now and coordinate the drain plan. @ops-kim can you handle statuspage + customer email drafts?
ops-kim: yes. drafting now. quick q: are embeddings affected or routed? need exact wording for public blurb. cc @eng-lina
eng-lina: embeddings will be routed to fallback region for the duration. Expect +100-250ms end-to-end for embedding calls from us-west1 clients. Text generation traffic will be drained onto warm nodes in same region where possible; occasional short queueing possible. No model changes planned.
support-jo: +1 on a short public blurb. also flag customers with Dedicated capacity in us-west1 — they may want direct notice.
cs-maria: I'll pull the list of Dedicated tenants and prepare one-off emails. Ops draft should include contact + expected impact and rollback plan.
infra-himanshu: we have 2 Dedicated tenants pinned to us-west1 (IDs redacted here). Will DM list to @cs-maria. We'll keep backups in us-west2 ready.
ops-kim: DRAFT STATUSPAGE ENTRY:
```
Summary: Planned maintenance to perform a rolling drain of serving nodes in us-west1.
Start: 2024-11-15 03:00 UTC
End: 2024-11-15 04:30 UTC (expected)
Impact: Short, intermittent increases in request latency (5-20s spikes possible) and brief request retries. Embeddings may see increased latency as requests route to fallback region. No data loss expected.
What we're doing: Performing a staged drain and validation of serving nodes, monitoring latency and error rates; automatic fallbacks enabled.
Customer action: No action required. If you have dedicated capacity in us-west1, your CSM will reach out.
```
ops-kim: DRAFT CUSTOMER EMAIL (short):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance in us-west1 (Nov 15 03:00–04:30 UTC)
Hi —
We will perform planned maintenance in our us-west1 region on Nov 15 from 03:00–04:30 UTC. During this time you may experience brief increases in latency and transient retries. Our platform will route requests to fallback capacity as needed; no action required on your side.
If you run workloads pinned to us-west1, your CSM will contact you with more details.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```
sre-aaron: looks good. I'll add a short internal incident-runbook snippet for oncall:
```
Preflight: run ./scripts/preflight-check --region us-west1
Drain plan: drain in 15% node increments, validate p95 latency < x ms, watch error rate < 0.5%
Rollback: pause drains and re-route traffic if errors > 1% for > 3 min
Post-maint: run ./scripts/post-validate --traffic-sample 1h and update statuspage
Escalation: page sre-lead if rollback triggered
```
support-jo: can we include an FAQ line — e.g., "Will this affect embeddings?" -> "Embeddings will be routed to fallback region; slight latency increase."
ops-kim: added FAQ to statuspage draft. tagging for review: @sre-aaron @eng-lina @cs-maria. Plan to publish advisory 48h before window and a reminder 1h before start.
cs-maria: I'll queue direct emails to the two Dedicated tenants after confirm from @infra-himanshu. Thanks.
infra-himanshu: confirmed, DM sent. maintenance advisory will be created in the ops calendar.
sre-aaron: preflight passed on staging. ready to proceed with advisory publish. once we start drains I'll post short progress updates here and update the status page.
ops-kim: publishing advisory now (48h notice). statuspage live draft: https://status.redwood.example/incident/psg-usw1-maint-2024-11-15
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2024-11-15 02:00 UTC (1h before) with link to this thread.
sre-aaron: thanks team. will update with any deviating conditions. closing loop here until start — reopen thread on progress updates.
